items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Stump Crouch, the cat that you see with Redd Foxx... It looked like Stump Crouch.

ctx.x: He sure did. I was with him when he did it.
He was a wonderful man. Now, Stump Crouch, the cat that you see with Redd Foxx... It looked like Stump Crouch. Was that him?
